ingenierie.name: L'atelier d'ingénierie · The engineering workshop
ingenierie.alt: The engineering workshop inside the honey-sandstone engineering school, painted in ink and gouache, with a huge gear-shaped round window at the back showing light snow. On the left the glass double doors stand open to the campus path; a young woman fixes her hair in the mirror-bright sheen of a chrome machine, a tablet glows on a stack of logs, an inventor unveils a fan blowing ribbons into an air vent, and a cardboard model town sits beside an open kit box. In the middle a robot arm pats a giggling boy's cheek beside his buttered toast. On the right two friends high-five on the stair landing, a silver robot takes a bow, a yellow digger with a boy in its cab, a device of springs and dials wearing a pair of goggles, a toy race car on a figure-eight circuit, a kitten asleep on a motor and a puppy peering down a stone well, and on the far right wall a lab bench of gadgets. At the top of the stairs, on the landing at the far right, a red door stands open onto the autumn Engineers Walk.

etabli.name: L'établi · The lab bench
etabli.alt: Close-up of the lab bench on the right wall: a spring-and-goggles device on the left; on the right a radar dish over a green radar screen, a glass pipe with a goldfish swimming through it, three silver transmitter towers sending out signal waves, a tiny computer chip beside a ladybird, an open clock full of gears with a spanner in it, a sensor with a big glass eye whose arm holds a baseball mitt that has caught a ball, a brass gadget with levers and a bell cracking a walnut, a winged model bicycle, a teapot robot and a rolled scroll with a red wax seal.
